The overview is the level-1 crop with greatest display overlap, or level 0 if unavailable.

geometries.method: Near-surface eastward core at about 7°N in repeated 140°W Pacific sections; not an alongstream endpoint.
geometries.positional_uncertainty: not quantified; no observed current core or path

length_assessments.illustration_limit: Drawn map-arrow span, not a physical current length or lower bound
length_assessments.scope: Repeated Pacific velocity sections identify a near-surface eastward core around 7°N at 140°W. The section locates the current but gives no comparable along-current length.
